name: DerInterconnectionQueueManager
tagline: Solar, battery and EV interconnection queue – utility desk and installer portal in one control.
description: Complete DER interconnection app for distribution utilities and co-ops: guided intake with document checklist, completeness review and information requests, first-come queue positions per feeder, size / inverter / penetration fast-track screens against hosting capacity, impact studies with upgrade costs, approval, agreement, inspection and permission to operate, business-day SLA clocks and an installer portal for Power Pages.
features: Queue position per feeder (first come, first served)
Feeder hosting capacity: installed / committed / queued
Business-day SLA clocks per stage (utility vs installer)
Installer portal role (own applications, anonymised queue)
Bulk assign / review / withdraw with undo
CSV and SummaryJson for Power BI and regulator reports
